organization: University of Sydney (Biercuk group; Makadia, Jee, Shankar, Wolf et al.)
processor: Rotating Penning-trap beryllium ion crystal (site-selective control)
notes: Programmable site-selective spin control in rotating Penning-trap ion crystals. Demonstrates single-qubit Rz(pi) at 94.6% gate fidelity with 1.2% nearest-neighbor crosstalk across large rotating beryllium ion crystals, enabling spatially structured spin patterns and dual-quadrature Ramsey sensing. RELEVANCE 2/5: large-ion-crystal addressing advance; a different hardware modality (Penning trap) from our trapped-ion/neutral-atom focus. Does not change physics anchors.
